messages:
maria (PM): quick sync — we need to lock the PRD for the Rate Limits Policy before roadmap review next week. Key customer asks (Acme, Atlas): per-tenant burst credits, per-model caps, and clearer billing semantics. Can we confirm scope & acceptance by EOD?

yuki (Eng): engineering constraints: we can do per-tenant dynamic caps + burst credits. per-model caps are possible but will change routing + caching; increases infra complexity. need to pick primary meter: tokens preferred (accurate for LL models) vs requests (cheaper to compute).

cal (Billing): preference is token-based metering for invoices. Overages should be billable by default (with opt-out throttle), but we need a grace period / dispute UI. Also ask: do we expose both token_count and request_count on invoices? recommend token_count + meter_id.

nx (SRE): from SLOs — throttling causes 429s; customer experience worse. proposal: token-bucket + soft-burst credits. If exhausted, return 429 with structured JSON and link to billing/upgrade flow. Canary rollout on 5% tenants first.

aj (Legal): flag — for enterprise customers we need audit trail of metering decisions (who changed caps) and exportable billing logs for 7+ years depending on region. confirm retention with security.

maria (PM): acceptance criteria (proposed):
- API for reading limits and current consumption exists and responds <150ms P95.
- Billing exports include meter_id, tokens, model, tenant_id, and timestamp (CSV/Parquet).
- Admin UI shows per-tenant quota, burst remaining, and change history.
- Canary rollout plan documented + automatic fallback.
- Edge behavior: when tokens exhausted, structured 429 with `retry_after_seconds` and `billing_link`.

yuki (Eng): quick API sketch (RFC level):
```
POST /v1/limits/check
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "tenant_id": "t_123",
  "model": "redwood/fast-1",
  "tokens": 512,
  "request_type": "generation"
}
```
Response: 
```
{
  "allowed": true,
  "remaining_tokens": 1200,
  "quota_type": "commit|burst",
  "meter_id": "m_tok_v1"
}
```
(we can expand fields later)

cal (Billing): +1 on `meter_id`. Also: invoice granularity — daily aggregated token buckets and per-request detail only for disputes. Need schema for events.

nx (SRE): recommend `remaining_tokens` be eventual consistent for scale; include `approximate` flag when staled. Also: include `quota_version` so clients can handle rollouts.

aj (Legal): add note: API responses should not leak other tenant info. Ensure `tenant_id` validation in control plane.

maria (PM): tradeoffs we need to decide today: 1) meter token-only vs token+request dual meter; 2) default overage billing vs default throttle; 3) UI scope for GA (minimal vs full admin history). Please reply with short preference + risk note.

yuki (Eng): my vote: token-first, fallback to request-only for legacy models. Risk: extra work to support dual-metrics in routing layer (2 sprint impact).

cal (Billing): vote: token-first + bill overage. Risk: customer disputes -> need quick export endpoint.

nx (SRE): vote: soft-burst + throttle after grace. Risk: user-facing 429s. Mitigation: help center + explicit retry headers.

aj (Legal): prefer throttle opt-in for regulated customers; billing-only for enterprise with explicit contract.

maria (PM): noted. Action items:
- yuki: PRD first draft with API sketch + rollout plan by tomorrow noon.
- cal: draft billing export schema + dispute flow by EOD.
- nx: canary checklist + SLO adjustments by tomorrow.
- aj: retention + contract language examples by Friday.

maria (PM): if any blockers (large infra work or legal constraints) call out now so we can re-scope for the GA vs Beta lanes.

yuki (Eng): one blocker: per-model caps require model tagging in routing; infra estimate ~3 wks if we do for GA. propose model-cap as Beta after GA.

cal (Billing): one ask: surface `meter_id` in the tenant billing UI and API by GA.

nx (SRE): deploy-bot will run canary when ready.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: rlimits-service -> canary-2026-03-18T22:00Z (5% tenants). Watch `rlimits.canary.errors` and `rlimits.latency`.

maria (PM): thanks — I'll assemble a trimmed PRD for review and mark model-caps as Beta. We'll reconvene after PRD draft. :thumbsup:
